svg.text: Cut 394 x 164 mm. Cut-outs from the panel cut-out layout picture,

svg.text: measured from the left and bottom edges:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: USB-C 16 x 8 (2), USB-A 13 x 5 (2), 12 V socket 24 diameter,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: barrel socket 12, switch 21 x 26, wake button 12, AC outlet 60 x 60,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: display 70 x 14. Check each against the part's datasheet first.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 4.5 mm screw holes: 6 and 388 from the left edge, 44 and 139 up.

svg.text: four M4 screws into the rivet nuts.
